newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Blue Square rated hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Blue Square rated hold.

text.p: Ofek Securities and Investments issued a "hold" recommendation for Blue Square Chain Stores Properties and Investments, saying an expected recession in Israel would affect the company in 1997.
"Despite this, the company is trading below its economic worth," Ofek said in a report.
It recommended purchase as a long-term investment, saying its results are expected to improve in 1998.

Ofek said a forecast slowdown in economic growth in Israel now appeared to be turning into a recession, which would likely hurt Blue Square's department store chain. The extent of the damage would depend on the severity of the recession, Ofek said. However, the company's supermarkets were more immune to a recession, Ofek said.
The report said Blue Square's fourth-quarter 1996 results surpassed Ofek's expectations and predicted sales in 1997-98 would rise at a rate of 12-17 percent.
Ofek estimated Blue Square, a subsidiary of Blue Square Israel BSI.N, would earn 78.3 million shekels in 1997 and 95 million in 1998, against 72.1 million last year.
